description: This PHP source file defines the class EmpContractDecorator, which serves as a decorator for the EmpContract entity. It provides methods to access formatted start and end dates of employment contracts, retrieve contract attachments, and associate an employee with the contract by employee number. It leverages traits for ORM helper functions and date/time formatting, and interacts with service classes such as EmploymentContractService to fetch related data.

classes.name: EmpContractDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the EmpContract entity providing formatted access to contract start/end dates, contract attachments, and employee association management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with the given EmpContract entity.

methods.name: getEmploymentContractService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmploymentContractService instance.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted start date of the employment contract, or null if unavailable.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted end date of the employment contract, or null if unavailable.

methods.name: getContractAttachment
methods.description: Fetches the contract attachment for the associated employee, if any.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the contract given an employee number.
